001package org.clafer.alloy.solve;
002
003import java.io.BufferedReader;
004import java.io.File;
005import java.io.InputStreamReader;
006import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
007import java.util.List;
008import org.clafer.frontend.ModelFiles;
009import org.clafer.frontend.ToIr;
010import org.clafer.ig.Repl;
011
012/**
013 * The solution loop of a temporal model with the Alloy backend, as
014 * {@code claferIG FILE} runs it.
015 */
016public final class Main {
017
018    private Main() {
019    }
020
021    /**
022     * Reads the model with the Java frontend.
023     *
024     * @throws IllegalArgumentException with the errors of the model
025     */
026    public static ToIr.Result read(String path, List<String> imports) {
027        ToIr.Result r = ToIr.toIr(ModelFiles.read(path, imports));
028        if (!r.messages().isEmpty()) {
029            throw new IllegalArgumentException(String.join("\n", r.messages()));
030        }
031        return r;
032    }
033
034    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
035        String path = args[0];
036        AlloyBackend backend = new AlloyBackend(() -> read(path, List.of()), new File(path).getName(),
037                AlloyBackend.Options.Default);
038        new Repl(backend, new Repl.Io(new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)),
039                System.out, System.err), false).run();
040    }
041}
